items.title: Magictools
items.content_text:
### Graphics / Texture Tools

*   :tada: [MeshCoat](https://stuyk.github.io/meshcoat) - Fast, offline desktop texture painter: load a 3D model and paint PBR materials directly onto the mesh, then export texture maps. [Source (⭐11)](https://github.com/stuyk/meshcoat)

### Graphics / Animation

*   :tada: [MeshAnimate](https://stuyk.github.io/meshanimate) - Pivot-style pose-to-pose animator for rigged Blender characters, with a simple timeline and onion-skin ghosts. Saves animations back into the .blend as normal Blender actions. [Source (⭐4)](https://github.com/stuyk/meshanimate)
*   :tada: [MeshRig](https://stuyk.github.io/meshrig) - Rig any mesh in a .blend in minutes: fit a starting skeleton, skin weights and IK. Writes a standard Blender armature that works anywhere a Blender rig does. [Source (⭐3)](https://github.com/stuyk/meshrig)

### Collections / Voxel Editors

*   :free: [DailySounds](https://dailysounds.org/?ref=magictools) - Searchable sound effects for games, with browser previews and downloadable audio; free for commercial projects under the DailySounds license.

### Music and Audio Editors / Voxel Editors

*   :tada: [Slip Sound](https://stuyk.github.io/slip-sound) - Fast, local desktop audio sample manager for searching and organizing large sound libraries. No accounts or file caps, with MCP support. [Source (⭐11)](https://github.com/stuyk/slip-sound)

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Interfaces

*   [Alchemist Coder (⭐5)](https://github.com/Alekla0126/alchemist-coder) - Open-source desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux that indexes your Gemini CLI chats, together with Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build sessions, into one local, read-only full-text search. Running Gemini CLI over ACP inside the app is planned for its upcoming Pro edition; the free edition runs Claude Code and Codex on local models.

### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [Concord MCP (⭐608)](https://github.com/Get-Concord-AI/concord-mcp) - Local-first shared work-state MCP server (`npx -y @concord-ai/concord-mcp`) that lets coding agents coordinate on one repo through presence, file claims, messaging, handoffs and review packets. Works with Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents. TypeScript, stdio, MIT.

### MCP Servers

*   [ppl](https://withppl.com/agents?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Personal CRM for humans with AI agents, with a hosted remote MCP server (OAuth) at `https://withppl.com/mcp`: Gemini CLI can look up contacts, log interactions, keep notes and set reminders about the people in your life. Free beta up to 1,000 contacts at <https://withppl.com/register>.

items.title: Awesome Claude Code
items.content_text: ### Mods / Data Visualization * [Review Inbox (⭐1)](https://github.com/SummerRiversound/review-inbox) by [SummerRiversound](https://github.com/SummerRiversound) - Claude Code mod that keeps GitHub work in a band above the prompt and a drawer: pull requests awaiting review, each summarized before it is opened, the user's own open PRs, and issues that mention or are assigned to them. Picked PRs go into the prompt as review requests carrying a review-style line learned from past review comments.\        ### Creative Media / Data Visualization * [Molecular Animation (⭐0)](https://github.com/AmadeusBio-ai/Molecular_Animation) by [Yangyi Liu](https://github.com/starryark) - A new-film skill, agent guide (AGENTS.md) and Python framework with which Claude Code drives Blender over MCP to turn a scientific brief and PDB or AlphaFold structures into a molecular animation film. The agent checks the brief's structural claims, builds the scene from a script, and writes a production record that tags every beat as experimental, simulation-derived or illustrative.\

items.title: Awesome Testing
items.content_text:
### Software / Service Virtualization

*   [OutageFence (⭐0)](https://github.com/jn6825rsr7-afk/outagefence) - Local HTTP fault-injection CLI by Slanta Cause that checks synthetic sensitive data against declared destination rules, with positive controls and offline reports.

### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [Browser Use (⭐118k)](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use) - Open-source (MIT) Python AI agent that runs plain-English tasks in a real browser. Browser Use Cloud adds hosted stealth Chromium you can drive over CDP from Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium, with session recordings and live view.

### Software / Test Report Diagnostics

*   [junit-collision-check (⭐0)](https://github.com/sunxiuguo/junit-collision-check) - Offline Python CLI that detects duplicate test identities and conflicting outcomes across JUnit XML reports before CI report ingestion.

### Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

*   [Site Spell Checker](https://sitespellchecker.com) - Crawls a live website and flags spelling and grammar mistakes on every page, each shown in context with its page URL. Free one-page scan; the full-site scan is a one-off $99.

### Software / Test Automation Frameworks

*   [VeriSpec (⭐0)](https://github.com/godikemahesh/verispec) - Spec-driven quality engineering framework that turns specifications into traceable test strategies, native test suites, and continuous release evidence.

### Python / General-Purpose Machine Learning

*   [mojolearn (⭐8)](https://github.com/mojolearn/mojolearn) - GPU machine learning implemented in Mojo with Python bindings for classical models and neural training and inference. In `identical` mode, mojolearn returns the same bits on Apple, NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

Python / General-Purpose Machine Learning

  • mojolearn (⭐8) - GPU machine learning implemented in Mojo with Python bindings for classical models and neural training and inference. In identical mode, mojolearn returns the same bits on Apple, NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
